scope.purpose: Prevent later reconciliation records, suffix collisions, bounded search silence, or reconstructed prose from being promoted into originating continuity authority.

memory_recovered: Continuity identifiers are not resolved by string equality alone. Resolution requires a conjunction of namespace, ownership, semantic role, temporal precedence, immutable locator, and coverage adequacy. Any failed or unknown dimension preserves unresolved status.

observed: The canonical queue requires immutable provenance or an unlocated classification after exhaustive coverage.
Current repository evidence is bounded and does not establish exhaustive refs or reachable-history coverage.
Later reconciliation commits establish later identifier usage, not originating assignment authority.
inferred: A single promotion rule is needed so future teams do not resolve provenance gaps using inconsistent evidence thresholds.
proposed: Apply this gate before changing any M-004, M-005, or M-006 node from unresolved or quarantined to located or authoritative.
superseded: Exact text match alone is sufficient provenance.
Later descriptive prose can recreate an earlier assignment.
Search silence under incomplete coverage justifies an unlocated classification.
unresolved: Reachable pre-boundary history and tree traversal.
Originating immutable objects for M-004, M-005, and M-006.

required_dimensions.namespace_agreement: Candidate belongs to the continuity_mining M namespace rather than an unrelated numeric suffix namespace.
required_dimensions.owner_agreement: Candidate source explicitly or structurally assigns authority to continuity_mining or its predecessor continuity function.
required_dimensions.semantic_role_agreement: Candidate is an originating assignment, decision, registry, queue, lexicon, or project record, not a later mention or reconstruction.
required_dimensions.temporal_precedence: Candidate predates the first known reconciliation or provenance-gap record and is consistent with the claimed assignment chronology.
required_dimensions.immutable_locator: Candidate is addressable by commit SHA plus path, blob SHA, retained source digest, or privacy-reviewed chat locator with stable retrieval metadata.
required_dimensions.coverage_adequacy: The search surface used to exclude competing earlier objects is exhaustive or its remaining incompleteness is explicitly non-material to the claim.

promotion_gate.decision_rule: promote only when every required dimension is true; reject when any dimension is false; retain unresolved when any dimension is unknown

contradictions_resolved.apparent_conflict: A later commit may contain the exact identifier and a plausible description.
contradictions_resolved.resolution: Identifier and semantic similarity are necessary lead evidence but fail temporal-precedence and originating-role requirements unless an earlier immutable assignment is retained.

contradictions_resolved.apparent_conflict: A bounded search may return no earlier object.
contradictions_resolved.resolution: No-result evidence can reject a candidate only within the searched surface; it cannot support repository-wide absence or unlocated status until coverage is exhaustive.

privacy_boundary.publication_rule: Store only the minimum locator and classification metadata needed to audit promotion decisions.

verification.method: manual schema and rule consistency review against the canonical queue and prior capability-boundary artifact
verification.reason: No candidate currently satisfies all required dimensions.

falsification_route: Present an immutable pre-reconciliation source object and demonstrate all six required dimensions; or complete exhaustive ref and reachable-history coverage and show no qualifying object exists.
rollback: Revert this additive commit; no canonical queue, registry, trigger ledger, or prior evidence object was modified.
